purpose: 読者の悩みに合う記事の装飾用アイキャッチ
prompt_brief: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: an original landscape 16:9 editorial cover for a Japanese career media, matching a restrained series of illustrated warehouse, truck, apartment and benefits covers. Contemporary editorial illustration with soft daylight, subtle paper grain, warm ivory, navy and muted periwinkle blue, sage and small apricot accents. Three or four large recognizable objects fill central 75 percent, elegant sparse composition that reads at 110px. No people, no faces, no text, letters, numerals, logos, watermark, invented charts, fake interface, glossy 3D or clipart. Subject: a blank desk calendar with empty unnumbered squares beside a pale blue pay envelope and a few neutral brass coins, a small sage leaf at the edge. Equal visual balance between calendar and envelope. Express comparing pay and days off before changing jobs. No scales, arrows, currency symbols or money amounts.
